spanish: E hizo la mesa, maderas de shitím; dos codos su largo, y codo su ancho, y codo y medio su alto.

findings.issue: שִׁטִּים is a common noun (feminine plural), and “shitím” leaves that lemma untranslated instead of Spanish.

notes: The rest of the clause matches the tokens: 3ms made, the table, plural construct wood, dual two cubits its length, one cubit its width, cubit and half its height.
